<system-reminder>
CUA inputs are still held:
- Key "shift", appHandle "fixture-app" (application input).
- Mouse left, appHandle "fixture-app", windowId "7" (window input).
- Key "w", appHandle "fixture-app" (application input).
They remain pressed across programs and turns. Release them explicitly with sendKeyEvent(key, 'up') or toggleMouse(button, 'up') on the same target when no longer needed.
</system-reminder>
